notes: The desktop installs pinned wheels directly; it does not install the upstream basiliskllm distribution.
gui/pyproject.toml and gui/uv.lock retain upstream project metadata and provenance; they are not the desktop installation dependency set.
Unregistered upstream provider engine source remains available for provenance, but the shipped registry exposes only Loom.
Required transitive dependencies and platform keyring backends are retained in each target lock.
